description: This file defines build configurations and device-specific image recipes for OpenWrt targeting NXP Layerscape ARMv7 devices. It includes device profiles, image build steps, and configurations for different hardware variants such as TWR-LS1021A and IoT board, with specific instructions for image creation, kernel handling, and filesystem setup.

classes.name: Device/Default
classes.description: Default device profile with basic image parameters, kernel configurations, and filesystem setup commands.

classes.name: Device/fsl-sdboot
classes.description: Device profile for SD card boot with compressed kernel and tar-based sysupgrade image.

classes.name: Device/fsl_ls1021a-twr
classes.description: Device profile for the NXP TWR-LS1021A board including specific partitioning and image assembly steps.

classes.name: Device/fsl_ls1021a-twr-sdboot
classes.description: Configuration for SD card boot variant of the TWR-LS1021A device, defining SD image structure and padding.

classes.name: Device/fsl_ls1021a-iot-sdboot
classes.description: Configuration for IoT device variant for SD card boot with specific image layout and compression.

methods.name: ls-append-dtb
methods.description: Appends device tree blob to the image.

methods.name: pad-to
methods.description: Pads the output to a specified size.

methods.name: append-kernel
methods.description: Appends the kernel image to the build output.

methods.name: pad-rootfs
methods.description: Pads the root filesystem to a specific size.

methods.name: check-size
methods.description: Verifies the size of the final image.

methods.name: ls-clean
methods.description: Prepares or cleans the image building environment.

methods.name: ls-append
methods.description: Appends binary components to the image.

methods.name: ls-append-sdhead
methods.description: Adds a header for SD card boot images.

methods.name: append-rootfs
methods.description: Appends root filesystem to the image.
